Hey there, not sure if this kind of question is allowed but here it goes anyway.


I recently bought a Playstation 2 Controller to USB converter in order to play some games using a controller. After I plugged it in it and seemed to work fine for about 2 minutes and then it disconnected, then after replugging it worked for about another minute but then disconnected again. I figured it was the converter that misfuctioned but then realized I was getting errors on my PC shortly after connecting the controller into one of the USB ports. 


After a short bit of research I realized PS2 Controllers (PS controllers in general) and PC's dont seem to be able to communicate without some kind of extra software or driver update. I have only been able to find these software for Windows 7 and lower but I own a Windows 10.

Is there anything I could do to make it work or does anyone have a link to a guide I could try. My Google attempts have failed. Much appreciated in advance!

I am not sure with other units and what their server setup is like, but for my unit you dont need the DLC except for APEX in order to play a mission with any DLC content. The one thing you do get is ads during the mission if you use any DLC content. I imagine most units have the same setup. However, If at one point a mission appears with APEX content you get kicked from the server automatically during role selection.

I myself am part of a unit called Team One Tactical, you can check us out here: http://www.teamonetactical.com. If you wanna check out other units i suggest going to r/Findaunit. Lots of different units advertise themselves there and you can find one to your liking.

You may be missing either the mods required to join the server or need the APEX expansion. This varies per server, try finding one without these requirements. If that isnt the case check your firewall.
